    if tokens[0] in ("d", "clear", "x"): game.clear(); game.message = ("info", "Deselected."); return
    if tokens[0] in ("g", "go", "submit", "enter"):
        if len(game.selected) != 4:
            game.message = ("info", "Select exactly 4 words before submitting.")
        else:
            game.submit()
        return
    unknown = []
    for t in tokens:
        if t.isdigit():
            i = int(t) - 1
            if 0 <= i < len(game.words): game.toggle(game.words[i])
            else: unknown.append(t)
        elif t.upper() in game.words:
            game.toggle(t)
        else:
            unknown.append(t)
    if unknown:
        game.message = ("info", "Unrecognized: " + ", ".join(unknown))
